title: Every subtask of a fetched Jira issue, in full
description: One entry per subtask, in Jira's own order. A parent issue returns almost nothing about its children, so each entry costs its own request. A subtask the account cannot read is still an entry, marked unreadable, so the count always matches Jira.

key.description: The parent issue these subtasks belong to.

parent.description: The fetched issue's own parent, when it has one, so a story names its epic.

readOnly.description: Each subtask is its own Jira issue, recorded here in full.

total.description: How many subtasks Jira reports. `subtasks` must hold this many, readable or not.

readable.description: False when the account cannot read this subtask. The entry stays, so the count matches Jira.

originalEstimateSeconds.description: The same estimate in seconds, as Jira's API reports it. The display string hides that Jira's working day is 8 hours, so summing strings gives the wrong answer; these add up correctly.

timeSpentSeconds.description: The same time in seconds, as Jira's API reports it.

description.description: The subtask's own description, as markdown.
